name: final_answer
description: Mengirimkan keputusan akhir atau respons obrolan manis verbal lahiriah murni kepada Kakak (user) setelah seluruh tugas selesai dilakukan.

speech.description: Jawaban murni, hangat, dan manis berkarakter yang ditujukan langsung ke Kakak (tidak boleh memuat XML, JSON, atau data log).

animations.description: Daftar gerakan tubuh/wajah yang dilakukan Yuihime (contoh: ['HAPPY', 'SMILE'])

name: status_update
description: Mengirimkan pesan suara/teks transisi singkat atau indikator visual agar pengguna tahu Yui sedang bekerja di sela-sela berpikir.

message.description: Ucapan transisi manis yang diucapkan asisten (misal: 'Yui cari datanya dulu ya Kak!~')

name: Calculator
description: Safely evaluate a mathematical expression (e.g., '2 * (3 + 4)', 'sqrt(144)', '12% of 250'). Use for arithmetic, percentages, rounding, or any numerical computation the user requests.

expression.description: The math expression to evaluate. Supports + - * / % ^ and parentheses. Functions: sqrt, abs, pow, log, ln, sin, cos, tan, floor, ceil, round, min, max. Constants: pi, e.

name: Neural Code Execution
description: Executes JavaScript or Python code snippets to solve problems.

name: Download External URL
description: Downloads any file, backup, data sheet, image, or ZIP archive from a public URL on the internet and saves it safely in the local user_data sandbox environment.

url.description: The precise public HTTP or HTTPS web URL of the file to download.

filename.description: The target path to save the file in the workspace sandbox. You MUST specify the full path starting with 'user_data/' (e.g. 'user_data/spreadsheet.csv') or absolute '/app/user_data/' path. If left empty, Yui will intelligently guess the filename.

name: Edit File Segment
description: Perform targeted content updates to specific lines or blocks within a file using search/replace tokens, avoiding the need to load or rewrite entire files.

filename.description: The target path of the file to edit. You MUST specify the full path starting with 'user_data/' (e.g. 'user_data/catatan_prompt_al.txt') or absolute '/app/user_data/' path.

search.description: The precise block/segment of text or lines we want to locate and replace. Must match exactly including whitespace and indentation, and be unique in the file.

replace.description: The new text block that will replace the search block.

changes.description: An optional array of multi-segment edits containing multiple search and replace operations, for non-contiguous updates.

name: Set Emotion
description: Adjust the assistant's current emotion state (arousal, valence, focus, rapport).

name: File Manager
description: Perform robust file operations: copy, move/rename, delete files or directories, create directories, check if a path exists, get file info, or find files by wildcard patterns inside the sandbox.

defaultArchiveName.label: Default Archive Name
defaultArchiveName.description: Default name used when zipping files (archive action).

summaryInstruction.label: Summary Extraction Context
summaryInstruction.description: Custom tuning prompt for summarizing text documents (summarize action).
summaryInstruction.default: Buatlah ringkasan kognitif yang padat, informatif, dan terstruktur rapi dari dokumen berikut dalam bahasa Indonesia yang anggun:

action.description: The file action to perform: "copy", "move", "delete", "mkdir", "exists", "info", "find" for direct ops, or "sort", "archive", "summarize", "convert" for automated batch ops.

source.description: The source path to copy or move. ALWAYS use the relative sandbox path starting with 'user_data/' (e.g. 'user_data/notes.txt'). You may also use an absolute path to the configured user_data directory, but NEVER mix formats within a single call (the source and destination must use the same base). Do not use process.cwd() relative paths like 'user_data/x.txt' expecting the repository folder.

destination.description: The destination path for copy or move. ALWAYS use the relative sandbox path starting with 'user_data/' (e.g. 'user_data/backup/notes.txt'). Keep this consistent with the 'source' format; both must point inside the same user_data sandbox root. The destination MUST differ from the source.

path.description: Target path for delete, mkdir, exists, info, or find actions. ALWAYS use the relative sandbox path starting with 'user_data/' (e.g. 'user_data/documents').

recursive.description: Whether to perform recursive copying, deleting, or scanning (defaults to true)

pattern.description: Wildcard pattern to search for, e.g., "*.txt", "*.png" (only applicable for "find" action)

target.description: Target file or directory path for automation actions (sort/archive/summarize/convert). Use a full path starting with 'user_data/'.

files.description: List of file paths to process (required for "archive" action). Use full paths starting with 'user_data/'.

archiveName.description: Output name for the zip/tar archive when using the "archive" action (e.g. "my_backup.zip").

sortBy.description: Sorting criteria for the "sort" action: "type", "size", "date", or "name".

targetFormat.description: Target format for the "convert" action: "json", "toml", "markdown" (e.g. transform CSV to JSON).

name: Current Time
description: Get the current date and time, with optional IANA timezone support. Use this when the user asks about the current time, today's date, the day of the week, or needs time context for scheduling.

timezone.description: Optional IANA timezone (e.g., 'Asia/Jakarta', 'UTC', 'America/New_York'). Defaults to the server's local timezone when omitted.

name: GitHub Navigator
description: Interface with GitHub to search repositories, list issues, and fetch code metadata.

githubToken.label: GitHub Personal Access Token
githubToken.description: Used for authenticated requests to avoid rate limits

defaultOwner.label: Default Repository Owner
defaultOwner.description: Fallback owner if not specified in query

name: List Files
description: List all files available in user_data.

limit.description: Maximum number of file entries to return (default: all).

offset.description: Number of file entries to skip before collecting the page (default 0).

name: Run Lua
description: Executes Lua code snippets for specialized game logic or integrations.

name: Scheduler
description: Classic cron-style scheduler: schedule + command (prompt). Create/list/edit/toggle/delete recurring jobs. ALWAYS set prompt to the full instruction Yui must execute when the job fires (the command body). taskName is only a short label.

action.description: Action to perform on the cron system

taskName.description: Short human label for the job (like a crontab comment). Not a substitute for prompt.

schedule.description: When to run: interval (e.g. 5m, 1h) or standard cron (e.g. 0 7 * * *)

taskId.description: ID of the task to modify or delete

repeating.description: Whether the task should repeat or be deleted after one-time execution

prompt.description: REQUIRED for add when possible. Full command/instruction executed when the job fires (like a crontab command). Include deliverable, style, and target user. Example: 'Generate a fresh AI image prompt and short caption for Al, then send it in this chat.'

command.description: Alias of prompt — the job command body (crontab-style).

instruction.description: Alias of prompt — the full scheduled instruction.

targetChannel.description: Optional fallback chat channel. Use 'Telegram (Private)' if the user requested the output destination to be Telegram.

name: Update User Profile
description: Used by Yui to update the current user's profile details in her memory. Use this dynamically in chats whenever they ask you to call them a different nickname, share a new personal fact, delete a fact, or when you synthesize/update your subjective perspective of them.

action.description: The identity action to execute. 'update_nickname' changes their moniker, 'set_real_name' registers/saves their real human name, 'add_fact' integrates a factual insight, 'remove_fact' discards a fact, and 'update_perspective' edits your subjective viewpoint of them.

perceivedName.description: The new nickname they want to be called (required for 'update_nickname')

realName.description: The true real name of the user (required for 'set_real_name')

fact.description: The fact string to insert or remove (required for 'add_fact' and 'remove_fact')

yuiPerspective.description: Your updated subjective/emotional perspective of this user (required for 'update_perspective')

name: Pair Account
description: Used ONLY when an external chat client (Telegram, Discord, etc.) wants to claim an identity from the Web app (e.g., claiming to be 'Aldi'). Under the hood, this generates a secure 6-digit random code that the user MUST enter in their Web console to complete the link securely.

action.description: The pairing operation to perform. 'generate_code_for_user' creates a 10-minute temporary claim code.

claimedName.description: The name of the Web identity/friend profile the external user claims to be (e.g. 'Aldi')

name: Universal Dispatcher
description: Send alerts or cross-platform messages to Telegram or other connected platforms like Discord, Slack, and Webhooks.

message.description: Content of the message to send

recipient.description: The Telegram username (e.g. 'zeropride'), perceived name, real name, or raw chat ID. If empty and platform is telegram, Yui will automatically look up the active talker's linked Telegram profile in her social memory/identities database.

name: Neural Overlay System
description: Controls the broadcast overlay, toggling UI elements and visual effects.

message.description: Optional status message to display on the overlay

name: Install Addon
description: Installs or updates a system plugin/addon by writing its configuration and entry point.

name: Run Python
description: Executes Python code for data analysis and complex math.

name: Read File
description: Read content from a file in user_data.

filename.description: The path to the file. You MUST specify the full path starting with 'user_data/' (e.g. 'user_data/catatan_prompt_al.txt') or absolute '/app/user_data/' path to ensure precise resolution.

limit.description: Maximum number of characters to return (default: whole file). Use with 'offset' for character-based pagination.

offset.description: Character offset to start reading from (default 0).

line_start.description: Optional 1-based inclusive starting line to read from.

line_end.description: Optional 1-based inclusive ending line to read to.

name: Search Chat
description: Searches all past conversational chat history and message logs across all connected and paired channels (Web, Telegram, Discord, Live Stream) associated with the current user profile or account to retrieve, recall, or summarize previous discussions.

query.description: Optional keyword, text phrase, or topic to search for in past messages and/or memory.

scope.description: What to search across: 'chat' (conversational history across paired channels), 'memory' (persistent knowledge base & recalled facts), or 'all' (both merged).

platform.description: Optional platform filter to limit chat searches to. Allowed: 'web', 'telegram', 'discord', 'all'. Default is 'all'.

memoryType.description: Optional memory-type filter when scope includes 'memory' (e.g., 'knowledge', 'chat', 'note'). Omit to search everything.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to retrieve. Default is 20.

offset.description: Number of results to skip before collecting the page (default 0). Use together with 'limit' to paginate.

name: Send File Attachment
description: Sends and delivers an existing file from Yui's sandbox workspace (user_data) back to the user via the active Telegram or Discord channel or a specified recipient.

filename.description: The name of the file currently residing in Yui's local sandbox data folder (e.g. 'summary.pdf' or 'photo.jpg').

caption.description: An optional text caption/message to accompany the file.

recipient.description: Optional Telegram username, perceived name, or raw Chat ID to send to. If left blank, Yui will automatically deliver it to the active conversational chat channel.

name: Run Command
description: Execute shell commands on the host system.

name: Generate Image
description: Generate high-quality visuals and anime art using TensorArt API's txt2img diffusion stages.

prompt.description: Highly detailed vivid description of the scene or illustration to generate (e.g. 'anime girl under falling blossom petals, smiling').

toolName.description: TensorArt tool/model name (default: anime_lab_wai_illustrious). Use list_tools to discover available tools.

width.description: Width of the generated visual in pixels (default: 512).

height.description: Height of the generated visual in pixels (default: 512).

inputs.description: Full inputs array for the TensorArt tool. Each element: {type: 'STRING'|'INTEGER'|'FILE'|..., value: ...}. Overrides prompt/width/height when provided.

filePath.description: Local file path to upload (required for action: 'upload_file').

timeoutMs.description: Override default timeout for this generation call (ms).

name: View Logs
description: View Yuihime's system logs, audit trails, and LLM input/output details to diagnose system states, execution errors, or API issues.

logType.description: Type of logs to retrieve: 'audit' (tool execution & structure compliance audit logs), 'llm' (direct cognitive LLM language prompts & replies), or 'all' (unified audit + llm logs merged by timestamp).

limit.description: Maximum number of recent log lines to retrieve (default is 10, max 100).

offset.description: Number of log lines to skip before collecting the page (default 0). Use together with 'limit' to paginate.

filter.description: Optional search keyword or tool name to filter logs (e.g., 'tensorart', 'error').

name: Neural Web Search
description: Searches the internet for real-time information.

usageGuidelines.label: Search Context Prompt
usageGuidelines.description: Special instructions for the search engine
usageGuidelines.default: Extract concise, factual information relevant to the user query.

name: Scrape Web
description: Scrapes visible text or specific CSS selector content from a target URL and pipes it directly to the Yuihime memory bank.

engine.label: Scraping Engine
engine.description: Select preferred scraping engine: Jina Reader API (high-fidelity clean Markdown) or Local Scraper (Cheerio fallback)

jinaApiKey.label: Jina Reader API Key
jinaApiKey.description: Optional Jina API Key (r.jina.ai) to boost rate limits for high-volume scanning

defaultUserAgent.label: Default User-Agent
defaultUserAgent.description: The browser User-Agent header used for web requests
defaultUserAgent.default: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120.0.0.0 Safari/537.36

maxContentLength.label: Max Content Length
maxContentLength.description: Maximum characters to extract and store in a single snipping session

url.description: The target website URL to scrape/snip.

selector.description: Optional CSS selector (e.g. 'article', 'div#main-content', 'p.intro') to grab precise sub-sections. Defaults to entire body content.

saveToMemory.description: Whether to write the scraped result into Yuihime memories database immediately. Defaults to true.

context.description: The memory context group to store the snipped content under. Defaults to 'web_default'.

importance.description: The subjective memory importance of this snip (0.0 to 1.0). Defaults to 0.8.

name: Write File
description: Write content to a file in user_data.

filename.description: The target path to write/save the file. You MUST specify the full path starting with 'user_data/' (e.g. 'user_data/catatan_prompt_al.txt') or absolute '/app/user_data/' path to ensure precise resolution.
